instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot at eye-level. Outdoors on a city sidewalk next to a stone wall and a green tree, the smiling red-haired White man (R2) on the left and the smiling Black man (R1) on the right walk side-by-side with their left legs forward. The red-haired White man (R2) wears a light pink open shirt over a teal t-shirt, dark blue jeans, and white sneakers, holding a clear cup in his right hand. The Black man (R1) wears a light blue open shirt over a light grey t-shirt, blue jeans, and beige sneakers. They hold hands, smiling warmly at each other as they walk. Soft, natural daylight illuminates the scene with a cool-toned color palette.
